flak.definition:
n a slick spokesperson who can turn any criticism to the advantage of their employer
n intense adverse criticism
n artillery designed to shoot upward at airplanes
flak.translation: n. 高射炮, 对空炮火, 广告, 宣传

flake.definition:
v. form into flakes
v. cover with flakes or as if with flakes
flake.translation:
n. 小薄片, 扁薄的一层, 火星, 晒鱼架子
vt. 使成薄片
vi. 剥落

flake down.translation: 雪片似地落下,纷纷落下

flake out.translation: 入睡, 昏过去, 昏迷, 昏倒

flakeboard.translation: n. 刨花板(用碎木片胶压成)

flaked.definition:
v form into flakes
v cover with flakes or as if with flakes
v come off in flakes or thin small pieces
flaked.translation: a. 睡去的；精疲力竭的；失去知觉的

flakes.definition:
n a crystal of snow
n a person with an unusual or odd personality
n a small fragment of something broken off from the whole
v form into flakes
v cover with flakes or as if with flakes
v come off in flakes or thin small pieces
flakes.translation: [化] 鳞片; 片状粉(粉末冶金); 白点; 发裂(钢缺陷); (纤维素塑料)干(片)坯料

flakey.definition:
a made of or resembling flakes
s made of or easily forming flakes
s conspicuously or grossly unconventional or unusual
flakey.translation: a. 古怪的,疯疯癫癫的

flakiest.definition:
superlative of flaky
a. made of or resembling flakes
s. made of or easily forming flakes
flakiest.translation: (flaky 的最高级) a. 薄片的, 成片的, 薄而易剥落的

flakily.translation: adv. 薄片地;薄而易剥落地

flakiness.definition: n. having or breaking into thin crisp flakes

flaking.definition:
v form into flakes
v cover with flakes or as if with flakes
v come off in flakes or thin small pieces

flaky.definition:
a. made of or resembling flakes
s. made of or easily forming flakes
flaky.translation: a. 薄片的, 成片的, 薄而易剥落的

flaky graphite.translation: [化] 薄片状石墨; 鳞状石墨
